scope: Recover source row/cell structure from a certified single terminal numeric column in a printed native frame. Native reading/ownership only; no OCR or language model.
rules: Two original vertical rails share exact endpoints after endpoint-exact joining, and a full original top rule proves the physical frame. An interior vertical rail keeps the existing grid authority.

Every numeric source line in the whole frame must certify a common sole amount rail and a common empty x interval between label and value. A valid local two-column fragment cannot authorize a parent with several amount lanes.

Every interpreted word has a complete original rightward horizontal flow/baseline and one existing owner. Existing comparison roles, typed grids including opaque grids, unpaired/unsupported numeric rows or orphan native words decline the frame.

A complete nonnumeric label and formal numeric field remain on their original source row. Unicode signs, decimal notation and three-digit comma groups are notation grammar, not page/company/value cases.
Consecutive complete source rows become two-cell rows only when the original full line bytes and prior word order are preserved. No source text is invented.
A detached sign requires its unique printed source Word, original baseline and position before its own amount. The original noise-to-used status is updated by the ordinary owner marking.
